speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Penny loaf. Still a thumb short of the notch. The price is a penny. I am not paying more, and I am not pretending the loaf grew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A thumb. I can see it. I am not arguing the notch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gregory will not carry cold. I heard you say it through the floor, yesterday, when the cat was the only other creature awake. Carry cold. It is a good line. I should like to say it in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will not say it in the yard. You have it wrong, and the yard is not the place I correct a line.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. The yard gets the loaf and the pail. It does not get his paper. Sit.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am sitting. I still like the sound of it. I will like it in the kitchen, where nobody is paying.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The heat is in the boards. I am not taking a story out of the house to cool it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a letter on the board. It says I am well, and that the heat is the news. It names no day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And it is not folded.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not folded. It is not going. I am not walking it to the Bell.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The carrier is Thursday the seventeenth. The seventeenth is not this sheet. Eat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I sand it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. Sand is for a letter that has a day in it. This one has none.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A letter with no day is a letter that stays a sheet. I am not offering to carry it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nobody in this kitchen is a carrier. The thumb is the news at this table. Pass the loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Passed. The notch is still ahead of the crust.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib has an opinion about the end of it, if you leave the end of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib has the floor. The floor is not the board. I am not hosting a second sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One sermon was enough. One turn. I am in for the night.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then the house is quiet, and the quiet is ordinary. I will take ordinary.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Ordinary is the penny, and the thumb, and a sheet that is not on the road. Clear the knives.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Cleared. And I have not said the line in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it that way. The line on the sheet is not the line you heard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The close has been walked. Dinner is the end of the day. I am not opening the almanac at this table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The almanac is already shut. There is no cross in it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then I have nothing to add. I am glad of the nothing.
